basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign the operating model of its five business units and plan the transition to it?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the current organization, process and cost baseline of the five business units and prioritize the areas to redesign.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Go or no-go on designing the target model for the areas prioritized in the diagnostic?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target operating model for the five business units and a transition plan for each unit.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final target model and transition plan by unit for the executive committee?

workstreams.name: Claims & underwriting
workstreams.answers: How do claims and underwriting organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in both units
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Sales & customer service
workstreams.answers: How do sales and customer service organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in both units
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Finance unit
workstreams.answers: How does finance organize its work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in finance
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Gaps and priority areas
workstreams.answers: Where do cost, workload and performance gaps across the five units matter most for the new model?
activities: Compare cost, workload and performance across units
Check gaps against operational data and customer feedback
Prioritize areas to redesign with the heads of the units

workstreams.name: Target operating model
workstreams.answers: Which target operating model options exist for the five units, and which one is chosen to detail?
activities: Draft target operating model options for the five units
Test options against the diagnostic baseline and gaps
Prepare the options for choice at the design workshop

workstreams.name: Unit-level design
workstreams.answers: How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance, two units at a time
Review each unit's design with staff who do the work
Check each unit design for fit with the chosen model

workstreams.name: Transition plan by unit
workstreams.answers: What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?
activities: Sequence the move from current to target model by unit
Identify change needs for staff in each unit
Test the plan with each unit's leaders

workstreams.name: Model and plan sign-off
workstreams.answers: Which version of the target model and the transition plan can the executive committee approve?
activities: Review the model and plan with the CEO, COO and unit heads
Resolve open points in the final model and plan
Assemble the final readout for the executive committee

deliverables.name: Sales and customer service current-state baseline
Cost, workload and performance gaps across units
Diagnostic findings and prioritized areas to redesign
Target operating model options for the five units
Detailed design by unit: structure, roles and governance
Transition plan by unit with staff change needs
Final readout: target model and transition plan by unit

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure access
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Will each unit give the diagnostic team its data and staff access from week 1?
agenda: Present the diagnostic approach for the five business units
Discuss the data and interviews each unit needs to provide
Confirm who in each unit gives access during weeks 1-3

events.label: Workshop 1: first baselines
events.purpose: Review two baselines, focus gap analysis
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Which issues in the two baselines should the gap analysis size first?
agenda: Present the claims, underwriting, sales and service baselines
Discuss the main issues each baseline shows
Decide which issues the gap analysis sizes first

events.label: Go/no-go on design
events.purpose: Close the diagnostic and decide on design
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Go or no-go on designing the target model for the areas prioritized in the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the finance baseline and cross-unit gaps
Review diagnostic findings and the prioritized areas to redesign
Decide whether to go ahead with designing the target model

events.label: Workshop 2: target options
events.purpose: Review model options, pick one to detail
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Which target model option should be detailed unit by unit?
agenda: Present target operating model options for the five units
Discuss how each option fits the five units
Decide which option to detail by unit

events.label: Workshop 3: detailed design
events.purpose: Review unit designs before transition plan
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Go or no-go on moving the unit designs into transition planning?
agenda: Present detailed design by unit: structure, roles, governance
Discuss transition implications of each unit design
Decide whether designs move into transition planning

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve target model and transition plan
attendees: Heads of the five business units
events.decision: Approve the final target model and transition plan by unit for the executive committee?
agenda: Present the final target model and transition plan by unit
Review the transition plan and change needs in each unit
Decide whether to approve and take it to the executive committee

architect_notes: Engagement length is estimated at 22 to 26 weeks; slower unit rounds and a longer target-model design would push it toward 28.
No Implementation phase: the engagement type is assessment, so the transition is planned inside Design, not executed.
No Handover phase: the executive committee receives the result at the Design gate; add one if each unit head must receive a plan separately.
Unit pairings in the three diagnostic rounds are a proposal for the partner to confirm.
The executive committee must approve the model but is not a listed stakeholder; add it if it should attend the final readout.

sub_questions.question: How do the five business units organize their work, processes and costs today?
Where do cost, workload and performance gaps in the five units matter most for the new model?
Which target operating model for the five units can the executive committee approve?
How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?

drivers.evidence: all five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance)

phases.name: Diagnostic

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phases.why: Five units diagnosed two at a time in three rounds; above the typical 4 to 8 weeks because all five units are covered.

phases.name: Design

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders

phases.why: Whole-model design, then five unit designs two at a time, transition plan and one sign-off cycle; above the typical 6 to 10 weeks.

sizing.levers: Run three units at once instead of two, or diagnose three representative units and extend to the other two from data.
